content: Seytaani jaɗɗiɗ Yeesu fiir
Wa Yeesu puloh kalaŋ Yurdan, raak Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh riifiɗ ɗe. Fuuɗseem kaɗɗukohhaa ɗe nduufa.
A nikka nga neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis (40), ndaam, Seytaani fiireeɗa ɗe. A ñamɗi ŋ neeh ceem, ŋ mirndaani a aɗukka.
Weɗi Seytaani woyoh ɗe ne : « Nik ne fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ɗah, woya atoh fii wa ɓoƴsuk mbuuru. »
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne : « Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne : “ Ɓo' na pesohe mbuuru dong haa. ” »
Seytaani ɓayya ɗe ŋ ɗiska uup ɗafuk, a teeɓpa ɗe, ŋ harmban ñep na marak, nguur ciŋ adinaani jen.
A woosa ɗe ne : « Nguur cii jen na ini ŋ ɗooƴ ca degu ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo te ŋ miniɗ ca eɗ ɓoyi neɓ po.
Fu teyɗuk ƴek ŋ fikiiso ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa ca one jen. »
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne : « Fiis ci woo ne “ Ƴekɗa Kooh Heɗ fu, te fu ñaamuk a yi dong. ” »
Seytaani ɓayissa ɗe Yerusalem, ŋ jol Kahnaŋ Kooh, a woosa ɗe ne : « Nik ne fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ɗah, faɗsuka ŋ kehƴi ;
Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne : “ Kooh hey nake malaakaaciŋ ɗe, ca niiɗ ɗa. ”
Te : “ Ca ɓay ɗa ŋ yaah ciŋ ca, po kot ciŋ ɗa laɓkanɗi ŋ atoh. ” »
Yeesu nammba ɗe lof ne : « Fiis ci namiɗ woo ne : “ Kana markisuk Kooh Heɗ fu. ” »
Wa Seytaani jaɗiɗ ɗe fiir po a miniɗɗi ɗe in, a cootta, a sekɗoheeɗa ɗe mbeh wiiriis.
Yeesu ŋ Galile
A Yeesu dokuk Galile kotii, raak ɗe riifiɗ na doolndiŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani. Ɓooɓa laamtoheeɗa ɗe ŋ kur caam jen,
a jangɗoheeɗa ŋ sinaagog ca, ɓooɓa jen laaskeeɗa ɗe.
A aaseeɗa, a puleeɗa kur ca po a reesa ŋ Nasareet, kur ka a yakoh. Wa mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ree, a aassa ŋ sinaagoga findi a meeɗa tumoh, a kurukka ne a jang ini fiisu.
Ɓa eɗta ɗe teerndiŋ woosuuɗi na woyse Esayi, a puliɗta ɗiski inii fiisu :

content.text: « Fuuɗsiŋ Heɗ ɓoo yii nga so,
laam a yi kooɗ to ne ŋ kom ñakiɗ ci Yegɗohiŋ Muci,
a yi woos so ne ŋ woo ambuuɗ ci faɗsuukiŋ ɓa,
ŋ woo fuuliɗ ci ne ɓa hey hote
te ŋ nam puliɗ torhiɗuuɗ ci ŋ miskiɗiŋ ɓa,
ŋ yegɗoh ne kiis kii, weɗ kiis ki Heɗ ɓoo teeɓohan baahkiŋ ɗe. »

content: Wa Yeesu ƴut, a lemmba teernda, a dokinndaa ƴaara na ɗaakee wa, a ɓooffa ne a woo ; ɓooɓa nikee ŋ sinaagoga jen yurhiɗkohha na ɗe.
A woosa ɓa ne : « Ini Fiis ci woyee wii te ɗu kerahhaa, wa raakiɗ woti. »
Ɓooɓa jen woyeeɗa in baahiɗ nga ɗe, ɓa feyuusa ŋ woo ca neɓiɗ ca a woo. Ɓa weeɗa ne : « Ƴaarii a kuɓu Suseef haa e ? »
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne : « Ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu hey yo woye woo kii : “ Paƴohi, paƴa haf fu. Ɓoo kerhiɗ in ca fu tum ŋ Kapernawum jen, tuma mand ɗaa ndii, ŋ kur ki fu genoh. ” »
Yeesu degiɗta ɓa nga ne : « Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh : Ali woosuuɗ na teyɗukseeɗi ŋ kur ka a genoh.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ jamanoonaŋ woosuuɗi Ilyas, wa Kooh toɓɗi kiis kaahay na camban te aɗ miskiɗ raakka ŋ kur ka jen, wa raak ɓitiɓ laayiɗ ŋ Israayel ƴaar caŋ ɓa kaaniɗ.
Moona Kooh tuuƴɗi Ilyas ŋ ali ɓitiɓ nga ɓa, waaye a tuuƴ ɗe ŋ ɓitɓa ƴaar ce nam kaan ya genee Sarepta ŋ kur kaŋ Sidoon.
Te ŋ jamanoonaŋ woosuuɗi na woyse Elise, ɓo' laayiɗ raakeen kosaay ki na oɓse faan ŋ Israayel, moona ali ɓo' wirɗuuɗi nga ɓa, waaye a Naaman ya genee Siri, a yi wirɗu. »
Wa ɓa kerah woo ceem, ɓooɓa nikee ŋ sinaagoga jen ayrukka po ɓa heeɗa pooke.
Ɓa kurukka, ɓa puliɗta ɗe kur ka, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ suunaŋ tangoora ɓa yipohee kur kaŋ ɓa ne ɓa yeñ ɗe a kaan
waaye a lahha ŋ harmban ɓa, a cootta waas ce.
Yeesu wirɗiɗ ƴaara jiini amb
Yeesu kaɗeeɗa po a reesa kur wiiriis ŋ Galile na woyse Kapernawum ; a jangɗeeɗa ɓooɓa ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.
A woyee woo kilifa, tahha po, ɓa feyuusa ŋ jangɗohiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ ɗooƴ sinaagoga, wa raakeen ƴaara jiini ambe, a leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka an :
« Hee ! Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, waas fu ye nga ɓoo ? Fu hay ne fu yah ɓoo e ? Ŋ inhiɗ ɓoyi fu nikoh ; a fu Ɓoyi Hooliɗi Kooh woos. »
Yeesu ngassa ɗe an : « Ɗeka, te fu pul ngaŋ ƴaari ! » Jiinnda folla ƴaara ŋ fiki ɓooɓa waaye a tumɗi ɗe in, a pulla nga ɗe.

Wa ineem raak, ɓooɓa jen feyuusa, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa an : « Cey, woo kiŋ ƴaarii wa woo ye ? Wa hun na hatil, jiiniici sah na hoolaaɗiiki ca hoolaaɗi, ca kerhiɗiɗ ɗe po a woo ca ne pulaat ɗah, ca saandohe ! »
Ɓa laamtoheeɗa Yeesu, ŋ ɗisik nu nik ŋ kur caam jen.
Yeesu wirɗiɗ kosaayiɗ laayiɗ
Wa Yeesu puloh sinaagoga, a kaɗta kahan Simong tel yaayiŋ ɓiti Simong kosaayiɗ po faaniŋ ɗe nikka dohiɗ jip. Ɓa kiimmba Yeesu ne a wiriɗ ɗe.
A hiirra nga ɗe, a ngassa kosaay ka, wa saɓsukohha na ɗe. Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska a kurukka, po a taambkoheeɗa ɓa.
Wa noha muy, ɓa raakee kosaayiɗ jen hayya ŋ Yeesu na ɓi jangaaro ɗalohiɗ, a degga yaa nu nga ɗah yaah ciŋ ɗe, yaa nu a degga yaah ciŋ ɗe ɗah, yeem wir.
Ɓi jiini puloheeɗa ŋ kosaayiɗ laayiɗ, ca leehkeeɗa ne : « Fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ! » Ca inheen ne a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse, tahha po a ngasukka ca, a faɗɗi ca ne ca woo.
Wa Kooh wiis, Yeesu pulla kur ka, a kaɗta ŋ ɗisik ɗaayiɗ, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ waakeeɗa ɗe. Wa ɓa hot ɗe, ɓa waaɗta ɗe amb ne a cootuu.
Waaye a woosa ɓa ne : « Ŋ joyiɗ nam ɓay Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wiŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, ŋ kur ci cinooci, ineem weɗ tah ho woosu. »
A taalndiɗta, a yegɗoheeɗaa ŋ sinaagog caŋ kur caŋ Yudee.
